subject: Judge: AST code extractor
description: Single-attempt review of the code-ast-extractor attempt. Verify: @babel/parser added; extractRepo emits the documented {files,symbols,edges} shape; functions/arrows/classes+methods extracted with name/file/line-range/signature/exported; CALLS + IMPORTS edges present; CLI works; tests assert real zonoid symbols (createWorktree, compileSearchContext, gateTask) extract with correct file+signature + a fixture unit test; PURE (no daemon/overlay writes); .graph/node_modules excluded; suite green. APPROVE merges attempt->feature; KICK_BACK on missing tests, wrong shape, or daemon coupling.

summary: APPROVE: Reviewed Phase 1 JS/TS AST extractor against codex/code-ast-extractor summary. Scoped extractor implementation, CLI, package deps, and tests are coherent: pure extraction, Babel-backed JS/TS parsing, function/class/method/arrow symbols, ESM/CommonJS imports, call edges, local import resolution, and focused coverage are present. Required checks passed after npm ci: node test/code-extract.test.js (35/35) and git diff --check. Extra npm test run is not fully green (221/233 files passed; failures are unrelated orchestration/claim/quarantine/judge-drain tests), with extractor-specific tests passing.
